description: The term refers to a combination of peptides utilized in fitness and bodybuilding to enhance muscle growth, promote a lean physique, and expedite recovery. These peptides work synergistically to stimulate muscle protein synthesis, increase growth hormone levels, and improve overall athletic performance, distinguishing them from other supplements by their targeted approach to muscle development. The peptide stack is primarily aimed at bodybuilders, athletes, and fitness enthusiasts seeking to optimize muscle gain and recovery efficiency.
